steps_basic.title: Make variables
steps_basic.instruction: Variables → Make variables 'secret' and 'guess' (for all sprites).
steps_basic.hint: Click Variables → Make a Variable → type 'secret' → OK. Then make 'guess'.

steps_basic.title: Add green flag event
steps_basic.hint: Events category (yellow) → when green flag clicked

steps_basic.title: Pick random secret number
steps_basic.instruction: Variables → set secret to Operators → 'pick random (1) to (10)'.
steps_basic.hint: Variables → set [secret] to. Operators → pick random (1) to (10).
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))

steps_basic.title: Ask for a guess
steps_basic.instruction: Sensing → 'ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait'.
steps_basic.hint: Sensing category (light blue) → ask [ ] and wait
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait

steps_basic.title: Store the guess
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
set [guess v] to (answer)

steps_basic.title: Check if correct
steps_basic.instruction: Control → 'if then' → Looks say 'Correct!' for 2 seconds.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
set [guess v] to (answer)
if <(guess) = (secret)> then
  say [Correct!] for (2) seconds

steps_basic.title: Add high/low feedback
steps_basic.instruction: Else: add another if: if guess > secret say 'Too high!' else say 'Too low!'.
steps_basic.hint: Click + on if block to add else. Nest another if inside for high/low.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
set [guess v] to (answer)
if <(guess) = (secret)> then
  say [Correct!] for (2) seconds
else
  if <(guess) > (secret)> then
    say [Too high!] for (2) seconds
  else
    say [Too low!] for (2) seconds

steps_basic.title: Test the game
steps_basic.instruction: Test: run 3 guesses; confirm feedback changes.
steps_basic.hint: Try guessing high, low, and correct to test all paths.

steps_standard.title: Do BASIC first
steps_standard.instruction: Complete BASIC level before starting STANDARD.
steps_standard.hint: You should have the basic guessing game with high/low/correct feedback.

steps_standard.title: Make 'tries' variable
steps_standard.instruction: Variables → Make variable 'tries'. Set tries to (5) at the start (after secret set).
steps_standard.hint: Variables → Make a Variable → 'tries'. Set it to 5.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
set [tries v] to (5)

steps_standard.title: Add repeat until loop
steps_standard.instruction: Wrap the ask+check inside Control → 'repeat until <(tries = 0) OR (guess = secret)>'.
steps_standard.hint: Control → repeat until. Operators → ( ) OR ( ). Condition: tries=0 or guess=secret
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
set [tries v] to (5)
repeat until <<(tries) = (0)> or <(guess) = (secret)>>
  ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
  set [guess v] to (answer)
  if <(guess) = (secret)> then
    say [Correct!] for (2) seconds
  else
    if <(guess) > (secret)> then
      say [Too high!] for (2) seconds
    else
      say [Too low!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Decrease tries on wrong guess
steps_standard.instruction: After each wrong guess: Variables → 'change tries by (-1)'.
steps_standard.hint: Put this at the end of the else block (after high/low feedback).
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
set [tries v] to (5)
repeat until <<(tries) = (0)> or <(guess) = (secret)>>
  ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
  set [guess v] to (answer)
  if <(guess) = (secret)> then
    say [Correct!] for (2) seconds
  else
    if <(guess) > (secret)> then
      say [Too high!] for (2) seconds
    else
      say [Too low!] for (2) seconds
    change [tries v] by (-1)

steps_standard.title: Show win or lose message
steps_standard.instruction: After the loop: if guess = secret say 'You win!' else say 'Game over. Secret was (secret)'.
steps_standard.hint: Use Operators → join to combine text with secret number.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
after repeat loop:
if <(guess) = (secret)> then
  say [You win!] for (2) seconds
else
  say (join [Game over. Secret was ] (secret)) for (3) seconds

steps_standard.title: Show tries variable
steps_standard.instruction: Show tries variable on stage; test a winning and a losing run.
steps_standard.hint: Check the checkbox next to 'tries' in Variables category.

steps_advanced.title: Do STANDARD first
steps_advanced.instruction: Complete STANDARD level before starting ADVANCED.
steps_advanced.hint: You should have limited tries, win/lose messages, tries counter.

steps_advanced.title: Make 'maxNum' variable
steps_advanced.instruction: Variables → Make variable 'maxNum'. Ask difficulty: 'easy/medium/hard' and set maxNum to 10/50/100.
steps_advanced.hint: At the start, ask for difficulty then set maxNum based on answer.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
ask [Choose difficulty: easy, medium, or hard] and wait
if <(answer) = [easy]> then
  set [maxNum v] to (10)
if <(answer) = [medium]> then
  set [maxNum v] to (50)
if <(answer) = [hard]> then
  set [maxNum v] to (100)

steps_advanced.title: Use maxNum for secret
steps_advanced.instruction: Set secret to pick random 1 to maxNum (replace the old range).

steps_advanced.title: Add even/odd hint
steps_advanced.instruction: Add hint: when tries = 2, use Operators '(secret mod 2)' to say 'EVEN' or 'ODD'.
steps_advanced.hint: If (secret) mod (2) = 0 then EVEN, else ODD. Operators → ( ) mod ( )
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
inside repeat loop, after wrong guess:
if <(tries) = (2)> then
  if <((secret) mod (2)) = (0)> then
    say [Hint: It's EVEN!] for (2) seconds
  else
    say [Hint: It's ODD!] for (2) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Add best score tracking
steps_advanced.instruction: Add best score: Make variable bestScore; set bestScore to 999 on green flag.
steps_advanced.hint: Set to a high number so any real score will beat it.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestScore v] to (999)

steps_advanced.title: Update best score on win
steps_advanced.instruction: When player wins, compute guessCount = startingTries - tries + 1; if guessCount < bestScore then set bestScore.
steps_advanced.hint: guessCount = how many guesses they used. Update bestScore if they did better.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when player wins:
set [guessCount v] to ((5) - (tries) + (1))
if <(guessCount) < (bestScore)> then
  set [bestScore v] to (guessCount)
  say (join [New best! Only ] (join (bestScore) [ guesses!])) for (3) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Add Restart button (optional)
steps_advanced.instruction: Add a Restart button sprite: when clicked broadcast RESTART; on receive RESTART reset secret, tries, and messages.
steps_advanced.hint: New sprite → when clicked → broadcast RESTART. Main sprite → when I receive RESTART → reset all.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
Restart button sprite:
when this sprite clicked
broadcast [RESTART v]

Main sprite:
when I receive [RESTART v]
set [bestScore v] to (999)
[run the whole game again]
